description: This file defines the Upgrade16 class within the Opencart installation upgrade controllers. The class handles database schema updates related to the 'subscription' table, specifically the removal of 'currency_code' column and renaming 'currency' to 'currency_code'. It manages execution flow for upgrading to version 16, including error handling, preparing JSON responses, and generating URLs for the next upgrade step.

classes.name: Upgrade16
classes.description: Handles the upgrade process to version 16 for the OpenCart system, including database modifications and response handling.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Performs version 16 upgrade tasks: modifies database schema, manages errors, builds JSON response with upgrade info and links.
